hints.title: 1D Perimeter Unrolling
hints.text: Project every perimeter point on the square into a 1D scalar coordinate ranging from 0 to 4 * side.

hints.title: Manhattan to Perimeter Equivalence
hints.text: On the square boundary, the Manhattan distance between consecutive chosen points equals their 1D perimeter distance.

hints.title: Circular Greedy Binary Search
hints.text: Binary search on the target minimum distance d. For a fixed d, greedily advance k - 1 steps along the circular perimeter and check the wrap-around distance.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Maps 2D perimeter points to 1D circular array and binary searches on the minimum Manhattan distance.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking all combinations of k points from n candidates is impossible for large n.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Projecting onto 1D perimeter converts 2D distance into monotonic line order.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognize that perimeter distance equals Manhattan distance for adjacent points and use binary search on answer.
